facts.rationale: The canonical implementation derives a facing-relative signed angle from the selected wall, ceiling, or floor normal. This improves the rendered ground-only name without claiming recovered original spelling.

evidence.why: All four surface categories can supply the normal used by the angle calculation.

facts.value: Implements the residual-motion contribution used during eligible grounded item physics. While x1F is set and xD5C is nonzero, it adds the contact-relative x88 vector to persistent x7C, scales and caps its XY components, and either clears residual XY and the active flag below the stop threshold or updates spin and adds x7C to the normal displacement. Because x88 is added before scaling, residual speed need not decay monotonically; clearing this contribution does not necessarily stop the item's other movement.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing guarantee of decaying motion and a complete stop while preserving the supported grounded residual-motion and spin relationship.

evidence.why: Shows accumulation before scaling, XY limiting, limited stop writes, spin calls, and displacement addition.
The caller supplies velocity-plus-nudge displacement and separately integrates other movement contributions.
